on Thursday launched a dedicated Gemini app for Windows. This brings it in line with rivals including OpenAI’s ChatGPT
, all of which offer dedicated desktop apps for Windows.
The app is available globally for Windows 10 and 11, and it can be opened using the Alt + Space keyboard shortcut and used alongside other applications, Google said in a blog post.
Gemini could be used for tasks involving Google services such as Gmail and Drive, as well as for generating images and videos with Nano Banana.
"Lightweight and quiet, the app runs without slowing down your PC. This is just the beginning for the Gemini app on Windows, with more native desktop capabilities rolling out over time," Google said.

title: Google launches Gemini app for Windows PCs
